gaps.title: Find a fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT circuit for cyclic count parity on 4 sites and window 2 with at most 20 AND/OR gates
gaps.statement:
let n := 4
let w := 1
let P := 2^(w+1)
let inv := fun (G : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (G.gates.filter (fun g => @decide (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) (Classical.propDecidable _))).length
let binary := fun (G : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) => G.size - inv G
let loc := fun k : Nat => (⟨k % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.succ_pos 3)⟩ : Fin n)
let fits := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ ∀ raw : Fin (n*P) → Bool,
    let entries := List.ofFn raw
    let pass := fun (x : Fin n → Bool) => ∀ i : Fin n,
      let word := ∑ j : Fin (w+1), if x (loc (i.val+j.val)) then 2^j.val else 0
      entries.getD (i.val*P+word) false = true
    C.eval entries = (((Finset.univ : Finset (Fin n → Bool)).filter pass).card).testBit 0
∃ C, fits C ∧ binary C ≤ 20
gaps.unlocks: a smaller circuit here refutes the gate floor L-clb-120 at n=4, window 2
gaps.context: A find is one explicit gate list on the 16 raw entries, checked by decide over all 2^16 tables (NOT gates free, AND/OR at most 20). L-clb-120 prices this case at 21 AND/OR gates: restrict to single entries per row to see each usable entry must be read, then count the forced binary gates. Search below that count; a hit refutes the floor of L-clb-120 at n=4, and a hand-back saying the floor stands is useful data.
